description: Nightly database backups that put the database password on the command line: a Next.js cron route builds `mysqldump ... -p${DB_PASSWORD}` for execSync, and a Python script passes a postgresql://user:password@host URL as a pg_dump argument via subprocess.run. Both are visible to every local user in `ps aux` / /proc/<pid>/cmdline while the dump runs. VC151 must fire on both.
